TEXT:
And so, the long-awaited trip with Ayase starts 
today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...You're going out?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Oh, right. You've got a date with Ayase today, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: How did you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ayase told me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're heading out as well?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah. I promised Kanako to hang out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Oh.

I appeared to be calm, but I must admit I was a 
little surprised by her.

I mean, Kirino answering honestly to one of my 
questions? Hope it doesn't rain today...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Hey, you! You just thought of something rude, 
didn't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're just accusing me of nothing!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: That so? Well, I'm off then!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Seriously, what's up with her attitude?

Well, nothing I can do about that. Psyching myself 
up, I headed out for the station where Ayase 
would be waiting.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, Onii-san!

Having seen me, Ayase showed a wide smile as she 
started waving at me.

...The sudden attention from everyone else kinda 
hurt, in a way, but I've stopped caring. Yep.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry, did you wait long?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: No, I just got here myself.

Oh man, Ayase-tan is so cute today, as always! Feels 
like ten more years were added to my lifespan just 
from seeing her smile.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Man, the weather's great today.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes, it really is...

And with that, our conversation was cut short... Huh? 
That's odd. Usually, we'd have more to talk about...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOTH
TEXT: You know--

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...You first, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Um, which train are we taking?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
The one headed for Atami in about ten minutes... Oh, 
and I've bought the tickets already, so don't worry 
about that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So, what did you want to say, Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Ah, no, I was just thinking maybe we should get on 
the train soon.

Saying that, Ayase bashfully looked down. What's 
up with this mood? My pulse is rapidly increasing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: L-Let's go then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, yes.

Dealing with the embarrassment, I took Ayase's 
hand and started walking. Likewise, Ayase held my 
hand steadily.

We boarded the train and were now on our way to 
Atami.

We were both so nervous that we just couldn't 
seem to start a conversation. Felt like our hands 
were burning with embarrassment.

Hmm, what should we talk about during times like 
these?

Glancing at Ayase, her face was completely red, 
and I could feel my face growing hotter by the 
minute.

Ah, but you know, Ayase's totally an angel. She's so 
cute.

I was planning to steal a glance every now and then 
when she wasn't looking, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
If you keep glancing at me like that, people will 
think you're... weird.

...Without anything else to do, I was looking out the 
window, and before I knew it, the train had arrived 
at Atami.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Whoa...!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Wow!

As we got off the train, both Ayase and I breathed 
a sigh of admiration at the scene before us.

A brilliant blue sky was now stretching out where 
there had been clouds this morning. We got 
wrapped up in the liveliness of the sight-seeing area.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: There's a lot of people here today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, it's been rather hot lately.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Oh, what could that be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? Probably a souvenir shop?

The change in environment helped a lot. As if the 
recent embarrassment hadn't existed, a 
conversation now sprung naturally.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: For starters, let's go to the beach!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sure.

Ayase, who had completely reverted to her usual 
self, grabbed my arm and we started walking 
down the streets of Atami.
